# Denver Cold Family of Companies

Denver Cold Family of Companies is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Denver Cold Storage provides cold, refrigerated, and dry storage and transportation solutions for East Coast coverage. Denver Cold Family of Companies employs 37 people (+8.8% YoY, +3 people) and has an annual revenue of $17M, founded in 1985. Headquartered in Denver, Pennsylvania, United States, with presence in France. Its workforce is distributed across United States and United Kingdom.

## About

The Denver Cold Family of Companies (DCFC) is an integrated third-party logistics platform delivering end-to-end cold chain and transportation solutions. Our companies include Denver Cold Storage, Denver Logistics, and Denver Freight Brokerage.

Denver Cold Storage provides frozen, refrigerated, and ambient warehousing, along with value-added services such as order fulfillment, cross-docking, blast freezing, rail access, and real-time inventory visibility.

Denver Logistics, our asset-based trucking division, and Denver Freight Brokerage, our nationwide brokerage operation, extend our capabilities beyond the warehouse—delivering reliable, temperature-controlled transportation and scalable freight solutions across the country.

Together, DCFC offers a seamless, full-service logistics solution from storage to final delivery.

# FMG Denver • FOOD MARKETING GROUP Inc.

FMG Denver • FOOD MARKETING GROUP Inc. is a Warehousing and Storage company. FMG Denver is a family-run 3PL that provides dry and refrigerated warehousing, pick-and-pack fulfillment, cross-dock, rework, and liquor compliance. They offer pallet to parcel services. FMG Denver • FOOD MARKETING GROUP Inc. employs 8 people, founded in 1995. Headquartered in Denver, Colorado, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States and Tonga.

## About

Food Marketing Group (FMG) offers customized warehousing and distribution solutions for the food and beverage industry.

FMG is centrally located, with operations based in the former Coors Distribution Center, ten minutes from downtown and two minutes from the I-70 and I-25 highway interchange.

Other companies will store and deliver your product, but FMG is the only warehousing and distribution company in Denver whose staff will work like an extension of your own company. We can guide you to make decisions that will increase efficiency, save money, and improve customer service. 

The end result: While you focus on increasing market share and building new relationships, we make sure that your delivery commitments are met and that your product is safe at all times.
